# ADO202: template-not-resolved

A template wasn't expanded, so its contents aren't linted.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Category** | Templates and parameters |
| **Default severity** | info |
| **Enabled by default** | no (enable with `--enable ADO202` or in `.adolint.yaml`) |
| **Checked on** | template expansion |

## Description

Local templates and repository aliases mapped to local checkouts with repositories are expanded. Unmapped repositories and template paths built from unknown expressions are skipped. Aliases in templates.ignoreRepositories are skipped without this diagnostic, even if mapped. Stages, jobs and steps passed to an unresolved or ignored extends template are still linted. Off by default; enable it to see which templates weren't checked. It is reported once per template per run.

## Example

Problem:

```yaml
steps:
- template: steps/build.yml@templates
```

Instead:

```yaml
# Lint the templates repository separately, or disable this rule.
```

## Configuration

Change the severity or turn the rule off in `.adolint.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  ADO202: info   # off | info | warning | error
```

Or on the command line: `adolint lint --disable ADO202` or `--enable ADO202`.

Suppress a single finding with a comment on the line before it (or `disable-line` at the end of the line):

```yaml
# adolint:disable-next-line ADO202
```
